label: MARKETING TERM
headline: Click-Through Rate (CTR)
body: Click-Through Rate (CTR) measures how often people click on your ad or link after seeing it, expressed as a percentage.
caption:
Imagine you send out an email about your new online course, and 100 people open it. If 10 of those people click the "Learn More" button inside, your CTR for that button would be 10%. Keeping an eye on your CTR helps you understand if your headlines, images, or ad copy are grabbing attention and making people want to learn more. It's a useful way to see what's working and what might need a tweak. H
